description:
Images whose `agency` field names a real space agency (CMSA, SpaceIL, USAF, CSA, Multi-agency, USSR Post) are grouped under the "Wikimedia Commons contributors" section on the `/credits` page instead of under their own agency section.

Expected: Each image on `/credits` should appear under the source-logos section for the space agency that produced / operated / owns the hardware in the photo, not under the conduit platform (Wikimedia Commons) where the bytes were downloaded.

Acceptance criteria:
- The 135 CMSA-agency entries (Chang'e fleet galleries, Long March, Shenzhou, Tiangong module imagery) must appear under a CMSA section on `/credits`, not under "Wikimedia Commons contributors". [spec: `src/lib/credits-grouping.ts` `agencyToSourceId` docstring: "the upstream publisher (the agency that flew the hardware / produced the image) wins over the retrieval conduit"]
- The 11 SpaceIL-agency entries (Beresheet fleet gallery) must appear under a SpaceIL section on `/credits`. [spec: Same docstring — the upstream publisher wins over the conduit]
- The 20 USAF-agency entries (X-37B OTV missions) must appear under a U.S. Space Force section or a dedicated USAF section on `/credits`. [repo-data: `static/data/source-logos.json` has `us-space-force` entry with `name: 'U.S. Space Force'` — USAF images should route there (USSF absorbed USAF space ops)]
- The 2 CSA / NASA entries (Canadarm2 ISS module imagery) must appear under the Canadian Space Agency section on `/credits`. [repo-data: `static/data/source-logos.json` has `csa` entry with `name: 'Canadian Space Agency'`; ADR-046 first-token-primary rule means `CSA / NASA` → CSA]
- The 42 Multi-agency entries and 3 USSR Post entries should not land under Wikimedia Commons as a fallback — they need a named section or be flagged as needs-info. [code-invariant: App must not silently misattribute known entities to the wrong source bucket]

Domain facts:
- CMSA = China Manned Space Agency (Shenzhou, Tiangong, Long March crew launchers)
- SpaceIL = Israeli nonprofit lunar-lander operator (Beresheet)
- USAF = United States Air Force — X-37B OTV is a USAF program, and the `us-space-force` source-logos entry is the closest existing section given USSF now runs space operations
- CSA = Canadian Space Agency (Canadarm2 on ISS)
- The `agencyToSourceId` function in `credits-grouping.ts` routes images by agency name FIRST, then falls through to source_type as a conduit bucket, per its documented editorial rule
